facts.authoredFrom: Read from the case's input bytes: the root grund.toml (version 1, `project_name = "root"`, `[workspace] members = ["power", "shop"]`, `include_root = false`); power/grund.toml (version 1, `project_name = "power"`, named sections, one untitled AR kind homed at docs with `index = false` and `value_chapter = "values"`, `[scan] include = ["docs"]`), whose power/docs/power.md declares AR-004-value-probe with its `values` chapter, the chapter root values.aux-voltage and its one component `24` (§FS-values.2.5); shop/grund.toml (version 1, `project_name = "shop"`, strict, an untitled AR kind homed at docs, `index = false`, `[scan] include = ["docs"]`), whose shop/docs/offer.md binds `48` to power's component through the qualified citation. The workspace-root run loads both members and no root project (§FS-scan.projects.workspace-root): the qualified binding resolves under power's grammar and value chapter (§FS-workspace.4.4, §FS-values.7) and mismatches, one error at the binding with power's component as its one site (§FS-values.5.2, §FS-output-shapes.1.1), beside one version caution per config in message order (§FS-check.checks.config-version-1.1). With no current project every generated ID is qualified (§FS-workspace.8.1.5, §FS-workspace.8.3.1) and an unqualified one is refused, naming the project that declares it without its section (§FS-workspace.8.1.1, §FS-workspace.8.1.1.6). A run from inside power, by working directory or by a path below it, is a member run that loads power alone (§FS-scan.projects.member): nothing cites the declaration there (§FS-check.4.1), its own config is the one caution, and every alias-qualified query is refused before any scan (§FS-workspace.8.1.3). A binding is never wrapped (§FS-values.8), so `fmt` changes nothing.
